tagline: Admissions • Fees • Hostel • Placements — ask me anything
status: Help desk is online. Replies in seconds.
fallback_reply: Sorry, I'm not sure about that yet. I've saved your question so the Gyanavedha team can teach me. Meanwhile, please email help@gyanavedha.example.

intents.name: greeting
intents.answer: Hello! I'm Veda, the Gyanavedha Institute assistant. Ask me about admissions, fees, courses, exams, hostel, scholarships or placements.

intents.name: goodbye
intents.answer: Thank you for visiting Gyanavedha Institute. Have a great day!

intents.name: thanks
intents.answer: You're welcome! Let me know if there is anything else I can help with.

intents.name: admission
examples: how can I apply for admission
do I need an entrance exam to join
which documents are required to apply
how to join the college after 12th
intents.answer: Applications for UG and PG programs open every March on our website. UG needs 12th pass (50% minimum). PG needs a bachelor's degree (50% minimum). Keep your marks cards, ID proof and photos ready. (Sample data for demo.)

intents.name: fees
examples: how much is the tuition fee
can I pay fees in installments
how do I pay my fees online
intents.answer: UG tuition is Rs. 45,000 per year and PG tuition is Rs. 60,000 per year. Fees can be paid in two installments through the student portal. (Sample data for demo.)

intents.name: courses
examples: tell me about the BCA course
what degrees can I study here
intents.answer: UG: BCom, BBA, BCA, BSc (Computer Science, Mathematics). PG: MBA, MCom, MSc (Computer Science). All programs are 3 years (UG) or 2 years (PG). (Sample data for demo.)

intents.name: exams
examples: when will the hall ticket be released
how do I check my results
when is the exam form last date
how many exams in a year
intents.answer: Semester exams are held in November and May. The timetable and hall tickets are published on the student portal two weeks before the exams, and results come out about 30 days after. (Sample data for demo.)

intents.name: hostel
examples: how much is the hostel fee
do you have a girls hostel
can I stay in the hostel
what food is provided in the mess
intents.answer: Separate boys' and girls' hostels are available on campus. The hostel fee is Rs. 60,000 per year including mess. Rooms are allotted on a first-come basis. (Sample data for demo.)

intents.name: scholarship
examples: how to apply for a scholarship
can I get a fee waiver
intents.answer: We offer merit scholarships (up to 50% tuition for top scorers) and accept government scholarships. Apply at the office with your income certificate and marks card. (Sample data for demo.)

intents.name: placements
examples: what is the highest salary package
intents.answer: Our placement cell organises campus drives every year with 40+ companies and offers interview training and internships. (Sample data for demo.)

intents.name: certificates
examples: how to get a bonafide certificate
how do I get a duplicate marks card
how long does it take to get my degree certificate
documents needed for a migration certificate
where do I collect my TC
intents.answer: Apply for bonafide, transfer, migration and other certificates at the office counter or on the student portal. Certificates are issued within 3 to 5 working days. (Sample data for demo.)

intents.name: transport
examples: which routes does the bus cover
how much is the bus fee
is there a bus from the railway station
intents.answer: College buses run on 8 city routes from 7:30 AM. The transport fee is Rs. 12,000 per year. Route maps are available at the office. (Sample data for demo.)

intents.name: contact_office
examples: how can I contact the college
I want to talk to a person
who do I speak to about my problem
intents.answer: Contact the office at help@gyanavedha.example or 080-0000-0000, Monday to Saturday, 9 AM to 4 PM. (Sample data for demo.)
